title: Maxwell's 1865 dynamical theory of the electromagnetic field
summary: Maxwell's Philosophical Transactions paper is a primary source for classical electromagnetism.
body: James Clerk Maxwell, "A dynamical theory of the electromagnetic field" (Philosophical Transactions of the Royal Society, 1865), is a founding paper of classical electromagnetism. Light, radio, and the forces between charges and magnets are, in this theory, aspects of one field. The paper is not a statement of the later quantum theory of light.
